name: techviet_multiturn_v1
description: Multi-turn evaluation dataset for TechViet Solutions RAG. Tests coreference resolution, follow-up drill-down, topic shift, multi-hop reasoning across turns, comparison, temporal reasoning, clarification, and refusal on unanswerable follow-ups.

conversations.description: User asks about an incident then uses pronouns to drill down.

turns.user: Tell me about incident INC-2026-0042.
turns.expected_answer: INC-2026-0042 was a P1 Critical production database outage on the Phoenix Platform on February 18, 2026, lasting 2 hours 47 minutes (14:23-17:10 ICT).

turns.user: What caused it?
turns.expected_answer: The root cause was a faulty database migration script that locked primary tables during peak hours.

turns.user: How long was it down?
turns.expected_answer: The outage lasted 2 hours 47 minutes (14:23 to 17:10 ICT).

turns.user: What action items came out of the postmortem?
turns.expected_answer: Action items included adding migration pre-flight checks, enforcing maintenance-window-only schema changes, and improving rollback procedures.

conversations.description: Coreference with pronouns and demonstratives on technical topic.

turns.user: Which vector database does TechViet use for production?
turns.expected_answer: TechViet uses Qdrant as the primary production vector database, as documented in ADR-001.

turns.user: Why was it chosen?
turns.expected_answer: Qdrant was chosen to handle large production workloads (~10M vectors for ChatAssist, ~5M for ShopSmart Reco, ~2M for LogiFlow AI) with low latency.

turns.user: Were any alternatives considered?
turns.expected_answer: ADR-001 considered alternatives such as Pinecone, Weaviate, and Milvus before selecting Qdrant.

conversations.description: Nested coreference: user refers to entity mentioned in assistant response.

turns.user: What deployment windows does TechViet enforce?
turns.expected_answer: Deployments are only permitted Monday-Thursday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM ICT. Friday deployments require VP Engineering approval.

turns.user: Who can approve exceptions to that?
turns.expected_answer: VP Engineering approval is required for Friday deployments or any exceptions outside the standard window.

turns.user: What's the escalation path if something breaks during a deploy?
turns.expected_answer: The runbook escalation path goes on-call engineer -> team lead -> VP Engineering, with SRE paged for P1/P2 incidents.

conversations.description: User progressively drills into a policy.

turns.user: What is TechViet's travel expense policy?
turns.expected_answer: The policy governs reimbursable travel expenses including flights, lodging, meals, and ground transport with approval tiers based on cost.

turns.user: What's the daily meal allowance for domestic trips?
turns.expected_answer: Domestic trips have a specific per-diem meal allowance defined in the policy (refer to Section on meal allowances for exact VND amount).

turns.user: And for international trips?
turns.expected_answer: International trips have a higher per-diem allowance than domestic, with region-specific rates.

turns.user: What receipts do I need to submit?
turns.expected_answer: All expenses above a minimum threshold require original receipts submitted via the expense management system within the stated deadline.

conversations.description: Drill down into onboarding with increasing specificity.

turns.user: Walk me through the new employee onboarding process.
turns.expected_answer: Onboarding spans Day 1, Week 1, and Month 1 milestones including account setup, buddy pairing, training modules, and 30-day review.

turns.user: What happens on Day 1 specifically?
turns.expected_answer: Day 1 covers HR paperwork, laptop and badge pickup, SSO account provisioning, security orientation, and buddy introduction.

turns.user: What SSO access is provisioned by default?
turns.expected_answer: Default SSO provisioning includes email, Slack, GitHub Enterprise, Jira, Confluence, and role-based access to internal tools.

turns.user: Is GitHub access limited by role?
turns.expected_answer: Yes, GitHub Enterprise access follows least-privilege with repo access scoped by team and role per the IT Security Policy.

turns.user: What is ChatAssist?
turns.expected_answer: ChatAssist is TechViet's AI-powered customer support assistant product for enterprise clients.

turns.user: What's new in the v2.3 release?
turns.expected_answer: ChatAssist v2.3 release notes cover new features, performance improvements, and bug fixes for that version.

turns.user: How many vectors does its production index hold?
turns.expected_answer: ChatAssist's production vector index holds approximately 10M vectors per ADR-001.

conversations.description: User switches topic mid-conversation; system must not over-rely on prior history.

turns.user: What are the standard working hours at TechViet?
turns.expected_answer: Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM ICT, with a one-hour lunch break. 40-hour work week.

turns.user: Actually, forget that — what's the GDPR data retention period for customer PII?
turns.expected_answer: Customer PII retention follows GDPR and PDPA requirements as detailed in the Data Privacy Policy and Compliance Handbook, typically retained only as long as necessary for the stated purpose.

turns.user: What's the breach notification deadline?
turns.expected_answer: GDPR requires notification to the supervisory authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach.

conversations.description: Abrupt topic change from technical to HR.

turns.user: Explain TechViet's microservices architecture.
turns.expected_answer: TechViet follows a microservices architecture with service-per-bounded-context, API gateway, service mesh, and independent deployability.

turns.user: What's the bereavement leave policy?
turns.expected_answer: Bereavement leave is governed by the Employee Handbook / Benefits Guide, typically providing several paid days for immediate family loss.
tests: must retrieve HR not eng docs

turns.user: How do I request it?
turns.expected_answer: Bereavement leave is requested through the HR portal / manager with supporting documentation as required by the Employee Handbook.

conversations.description: Answer requires bridging info from multiple docs across turns.

turns.user: What are TechViet's Q1 2026 OKRs for the engineering org?
turns.expected_answer: Q1 2026 engineering OKRs cover reliability, velocity, and product delivery targets as detailed in the OKR document.

turns.user: Which active projects contribute to those OKRs?
turns.expected_answer: Active Q1 2026 projects include Phoenix Platform, ChatAssist v2.3, Cloud Migration, and other initiatives tracked in the Q1 Project Status report.

turns.user: Did the INC-2026-0042 incident put any of those OKRs at risk?
turns.expected_answer: INC-2026-0042 affected Phoenix Platform which is a Q1 OKR contributor; the postmortem action items and status report note the reliability impact.

conversations.description: Synthesize security audit findings with policy.

turns.user: What were the key findings of the 2025 annual security audit?
turns.expected_answer: The 2025 annual security audit identified findings across access control, data protection, and incident response maturity.

turns.user: Which of those findings are addressed in the current IT Security Policy?
turns.expected_answer: The IT Security Policy addresses several audit findings including access control standards, password/SSO policy, and data handling controls.

turns.user: And which are still open gaps?
turns.expected_answer: Open gaps are findings not yet fully covered by policy updates, typically tracked as remediation items with owners and deadlines in the audit report.

conversations.description: User builds a comparison across turns.

turns.user: What are the engineering standards for code review?
turns.expected_answer: Engineering standards require at least one approving reviewer, passing CI, and adherence to style/test coverage rules before merge.

turns.user: How do those compare to the DevOps bootcamp recommendations?
turns.expected_answer: The DevOps bootcamp recommendations align with Engineering Standards but add CI/CD pipeline guidance, infrastructure-as-code, and observability practices.

turns.user: Which one is mandatory?
turns.expected_answer: Engineering Standards are mandatory policy; DevOps Bootcamp materials are training recommendations.

conversations.description: Compare SLA tiers via progressive follow-ups.

turns.user: What SLA tiers does TechViet offer to clients?
turns.expected_answer: The Client SLA Playbook defines multiple tiers (e.g., Standard, Premium, Enterprise) with distinct uptime, response time, and support commitments.

turns.user: What's the uptime guarantee for the top tier?
turns.expected_answer: The top (Enterprise) SLA tier typically guarantees the highest uptime, e.g., 99.95% or 99.99% depending on service.

turns.user: And the difference from Standard?
turns.expected_answer: Standard tier has lower uptime (e.g., 99.5%), slower response SLAs, and fewer support channels compared to Enterprise.

turns.user: When did TechViet start its cloud migration?
turns.expected_answer: The Cloud Migration Strategy document defines the timeline and phases for the migration program.

turns.user: Was the Phoenix Platform incident before or after the migration completed?
turns.expected_answer: INC-2026-0042 (Feb 18, 2026) occurred during the ongoing cloud migration program per the migration strategy timeline.

turns.user: What's the next major milestone on the 2026 product roadmap?
turns.expected_answer: The 2026 Product Roadmap lists upcoming milestones per quarter including product launches and platform upgrades.

conversations.description: User asks ambiguous question then clarifies.

turns.user: Tell me about the pipeline.
turns.expected_answer: There are multiple pipelines documented - CI/CD pipelines (Engineering Standards, DevOps) and data engineering pipelines. Please clarify which you mean.

turns.user: I meant the data engineering pipeline.
turns.expected_answer: The Data Engineering Pipeline Manual describes ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving stages with tooling per stage.

turns.user: What tools are used for ingestion?
turns.expected_answer: Ingestion uses tools such as Kafka, Airbyte, or similar as documented in the Data Engineering Pipeline Manual.

conversations.description: Follow-up asks for info NOT in corpus; system should refuse.

turns.user: What vendors does TechViet use for procurement?
turns.expected_answer: The Procurement Vendor Policy lists approved vendor categories and selection criteria.

turns.user: What was the total procurement spend in 2024?
OK, what about the vendor approval process then?
turns.expected_answer: The vendor approval process requires submission through procurement, legal/security review, and sign-off per the vendor policy thresholds.

conversations.description: User corrects themselves mid-conversation; system must use the corrected info, not the original.

turns.user: What were the Q4 2025 engineering OKRs?
turns.expected_answer: The Quarterly Business Review covers Q4 2025 performance highlights including reliability, delivery, and product outcomes.

turns.user: Sorry, I meant Q1 2026, not Q4 2025.
turns.expected_answer: Q1 2026 engineering OKRs cover reliability, velocity, and product delivery targets as detailed in the Q1 2026 OKR document.

turns.user: Which active projects contribute to those?
turns.expected_answer: Active Q1 2026 projects contributing to Q1 OKRs include Phoenix Platform, ChatAssist v2.3, Cloud Migration, and other initiatives from the Q1 2026 Project Status report — not Q4 2025 items.
